body:
## Why

The scheduled belt scan is currently broken at the rate-limit preflight, before it can identify a ready pull request. On `main` at `864b6e3053ce5135e8bc56cfac308edd56fa0108`, scheduled runs [35862732312](https://github.com/stranske/Workflows/actions/runs/35862732312), [35865818556](https://github.com/stranske/Workflows/actions/runs/35865818556), and [35868514826](https://github.com/stranske/Workflows/actions/runs/35868514826) all fail the `Execute / Scan belt promotion queue` job with `TypeError: 'get' on proxy ... __getTokenSource ... non-configurable data property`.

`.github/scripts/github-rate-limited-wrapper.js:215-220` defines `__getTokenSource` as a non-configurable, non-writable property on the proxy target, while its `get` trap at `:181-204` binds every function and therefore returns a different function. `.github/scripts/github-api-with-retry.js:1001-1003` reads that property when the client is already wrapped. `.github/workflows/reusable-70-orchestrator-main.yml:3219-3232` performs precisely that wrapped preflight before calling `identifyReadyCodexPRs`.

## Scope

Repair the metadata read so the rate-limit proxy satisfies JavaScript Proxy invariants and the belt promotion scan can reach `identifyReadyCodexPRs` when the API budget is safe.

## Non-Goals

- Do not weaken the fail-closed API-budget policy, change reserve arithmetic, or make the belt scan fail open.
- Do not modify unrelated dispatch or auto-merge jobs.
- Scaffold-only completion does NOT count: a test that merely mocks an unwrapped object, or a green run that does not exercise the non-configurable `__getTokenSource` metadata path, is not a resolution.

## Tasks

- [ ] In `.github/scripts/github-rate-limited-wrapper.js`, make the proxy `get` trap return the target's actual value for non-configurable, non-writable metadata such as `__getTokenSource`, rather than returning a bound replacement function.
- [ ] In `.github/scripts/__tests__/github-api-with-retry.test.js`, add a regression that creates a wrapped client with a working `rest.rateLimit.get`, calls `checkRateLimitStatus`, and asserts a safe status plus the original token-source value.
- [ ] In `.github/scripts/__tests__/github-rate-limited-wrapper.test.js`, assert that accessing `wrapped.__getTokenSource` preserves the function identity required by the proxy invariant.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `node --test .github/scripts/__tests__/github-api-with-retry.test.js .github/scripts/__tests__/github-rate-limited-wrapper.test.js` passes, including the named wrapped-client `checkRateLimitStatus` regression.
- [ ] Deliberate-break proof: temporarily restore function binding for `__getTokenSource` in `.github/scripts/github-rate-limited-wrapper.js`; the named wrapped-client regression fails with the proxy-invariant error, then revert that temporary mutation before committing.
- [ ] A post-merge scheduled `Agents 70 Orchestrator` run reaches `Execute / Scan belt promotion queue` without the `__getTokenSource` Proxy `TypeError`; capture the run URL in the PR evidence.

## Implementation Notes

The three current-tip failed runs are live reproduction evidence, not a capacity shortage: the failed job logged a selected `WORKFLOWS_APP` token with 4,728 remaining before the JavaScript exception. Keep the rate-limit check before candidate selection.
title: [P1] Belt scan crashes on rate-limit proxy metadata before it can identify ready PRs
